# quotes content

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/quotesContent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a work (a posting, an article) to content it quotes — another posting, a passage, an external resource. Non-functional: a work may quote several sources. Projects to [schema:Quotation](https://schema.org/Quotation) / [schema:citation.](https://schema.org/citation.) The quoted passage's text rides [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md) when inline.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

Use [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) from [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a work to another resource it quotes — a quoted post, cited passage, or external page; non-functional, so a work may quote several sources.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a repost/boost that carries the original wholesale (that is [`gmeow:sharesContent`](gmeow-sharesContent.md)) and avoid it for a formal scholarly reference (use [`gmeow:bibliographicCitation`](gmeow-bibliographicCitation.md)).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) at the quoted resource via [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md); when the quote is an inline passage rather than a linkable resource, carry the text on [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md). Projects to [schema:Quotation](https://schema.org/Quotation) / citation.

### Examples

- ex:post [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) ex:original; [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md) "the relevant passage".
